location_desc: Velociraptor fossils were discovered in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia and China. It lived in dry, sandy desert environments with sparse vegetation during the Late Cretaceous period.
fun_facts: Despite what movies show, real Velociraptors were only about the size of a turkey — not as big as a human!
Velociraptor had feathers, just like modern birds. It is closely related to today's birds.
It had a large curved claw on each foot that it used like a hook to catch prey.
Velociraptor was very smart for a dinosaur and may have hunted in groups.
Its name means 'swift thief' in Latin — and it really was very fast!

translations.title: Velociraptor
translations.description: Velociraptor was a fast and clever small dinosaur that lived in the deserts of Mongolia about 75 million years ago. It had feathers like a bird and a sharp curved claw on each foot. Despite how they appear in movies, real Velociraptors were only about the size of a big turkey!

translations.title: Khủng Long Velociraptor
translations.description: Velociraptor là loài khủng long nhỏ nhanh nhẹn và thông minh sống ở sa mạc Mông Cổ vào khoảng 75 triệu năm trước. Nó có lông vũ giống như chim và móng vuốt cong sắc bén ở mỗi chân. Mặc dù xuất hiện như vậy trong phim, Velociraptor thật sự chỉ to bằng một con gà tây lớn!
